title: The Choir of Ashvale
author: Oscar Joubert
blurb: Petra Winterbourne, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
